delivery_contract.material_policy: Preserve native Cape Base, Cape Trim and Cape Detail materials, existing tints and emblems.
delivery_contract.clock_policy: Phase-averaged, closed steady loops sampled in actual body-clip seconds; intrinsic attacks exclude the reference run history, and transitions carry the actual outgoing cape state.
delivery_contract.review_episode_equivalence: The runtime adapter preserves the accepted fit and motion character; it does not replay the complete three-second authoring episodes at every native phase.
delivery_contract.collision_policy: Extra body/gear guards are bypassed only for the full reviewed reference kit; weapon/shield changes and cross-profile clip data restore guards.
delivery_contract.fallback_policy: Unsupported and native cinematic clips use the bridged legacy Verlet writer on the approved fit. Mounted actors use original legacy geometry, skin and solver; approved geometry is rebuilt after dismount or failed mount setup. Inactive quality and crowd tiers hold the approved idle cheaply.
delivery_contract.body_animation_policy: The source body animation library remains authoritative; the adapter writes only twelve cape poses after body animation.

qualification.installed_actor_geometry_and_motion: pass: 1362 checks, eight reference cases, native graphics idle/run captures for both outfits
qualification.canonical_rig_compatibility: pass: 16 canonical rig global rests compatible; maximum body rest origin difference below 0.734 micrometres
qualification.body_pose_preservation: pass: 65 native body rests and body animation ownership retained; cape-only writer
qualification.action_switches_and_loop_boundaries: pass: clip phase/rates/aliases, steady closed loops, intrinsic attacks and outgoing carry
qualification.shipping_and_native_import: pending integration owner completion after authorized develop integration
qualification.transition_regressions: pass: exact-context guard bypass, authored-to-Verlet substep hold, weapon/profile changes, aliases, mount/dismount geometry and skin restoration

limitations: Visual acceptance covers the two reference outfits and five reviewed animations. Rest compatibility across the canonical rigs is separate from exhaustive visual review of every equipment combination.
Small upper-back garment seam contacts remain in the authoring reference; installed gameplay contact results are recorded separately.

Runtime loops are a phase-averaged projection of accepted source motion. Native mesh/weight packing contributes to the measured sub-0.2 mm idle source difference. Mounted motion deliberately retains the qualified legacy geometry and solver.

runtime_schema.skin_bind_contract: 17 named bind slots; first 12 are the cape controls; eight influences per vertex
runtime_schema.curve_clock: Original native clip seconds, phase-averaged closed locomotion, intrinsic attack plus actual outgoing carry
